lines: Hoshwalon ko khabar kya, bekhudi kya cheez hai?
couplets.en: What would the clearheaded know of losing themselves?

lines: Unse nazrein kya milin, roshan fizayen ho gayin
couplets.en: Our eyes met, and the air grew bright.

lines: Aaj jaana, pyaar ki jaadugari kya cheez hai
couplets.en: Today I learned what magic love can work.
Fall in love, and then you may understand.

lines: Ishq kije, phir samajhiye, zindagi kya cheez hai
couplets.en: Fall in love, and then you may understand what it is to live.

lines: Khulti zulfon ne sikhayi mausamon ko shayari
couplets.en: Their hair fell loose and taught the seasons poetry.

lines: Jhhukti aankhon ne bataya, maikashi kya cheez hai
